text:
mktg-ana: Quick check — final launch blog draft ready for preflight? Need legal + design signoff by EOD so we can schedule publish for Tue 9am PT. Also want benchmark call-outs and webinar CTA. @designer-maya @legal-tina @content-sam

content-sam: Uploading latest draft now: https://drive.redwood/launch-draft-v7 (bottom has headline variants + bullets). Short social copy included.

designer-maya: On it. Will tweak hero (compress to ~80kb) and confirm alt text. Any hero copy changes? :art: 

mktg-ana: Prefer the "Make inference predictable" hero line. Also want to highlight the benchmark stat — "2x throughput at 30% lower cost" — is that cleared?

growth-elliot: That's a strong hook, but we need the benchmark snapshot approval from eng before we publish it. @pm-jamal can you confirm source and test id?

pm-jamal: Confirmed — test id run-2026-02-infer-bench-03. Data is median across our small/medium/large workloads, quantized and FP16 runs excluded. Saved charts in the doc.

legal-tina: I need the source file + 2-sentence methodology blurb in the post (how the sample was measured). Also prefer conservative language — avoid absolute claims vs competitors. I can sign off after that.

content-sam: Added methodology note and embedded the benchmark chart (png) under the "benchmarks" section. Also added webinar CTA: "Join our launch webinar — register: https://redwood.com/webinar/register"

ops-jen: For inbound lead routing — confirm HubSpot form id and UTM params so the publish workflow routes correctly. Recommended: form_id=5-launch-cta; utm_source=blog; utm_medium=referral; utm_campaign=dedicated-launch

mktg-ana: Perfect. Whoever publishes, please use publish time 2026-03-10T16:00:00Z (Tue 9am PT). publish-bot, can you queue this with the form_id and UTMs?

publish-bot: Scheduled: 2026-03-10T16:00:00Z. Post queued with HS form 5-launch-cta and UTM params. Will ping when live. :white_check_mark:

designer-maya: Submitted hero/social assets in /assets/launch/ — optimized PNG + OG image.

content-sam: One last small ask from legal: change "2x throughput" -> "up to 2x throughput" to tone down the claim. Made the edit in v7.

mktg-ana: Good catch — switching wording now. Thanks all. If no objections by 5pm PT, I'll hit the publish workflow and confirm the webinar CTA links + lead routing.

legal-tina: Thanks — that's acceptable. I give conditional approval pending the methodology blurb remains visible on-page.

mktg-ana: Awesome — will finalize and follow up with a quick checklist in this thread once publish is queued. Thanks team! :rocket:
